projects.title: Violet — Cyberpunk Story
projects.brief: A cinematic cyberpunk narrative exploring identity, neural lighting, and hyper-detailed dystopian worldbuilding.
projects.challenge: Achieving photorealistic character consistency, coherent cinematic camera movement, and volumetric neon lighting using multi-stage neural diffusion.
projects.solution: Engineered custom LoRA character models coupled with ComfyUI depth-control pipelines and DaVinci Resolve ACES color grading.
projects.outcome: An unmistakable cinematic commercial that establishes a new visual benchmark for generative AI storytelling.
projects.theIdea: In a rain-slicked cyberpunk metropolis, synthetic intelligence and human emotion collide. Violet navigates corporate surveillance and digital undergrounds.
projects.theApproach: We avoided generic AI novelty in favor of controlled camera tracking, low-angle anamorphic framing, and deep atmospheric color grading.
projects.theExecution: Multi-pass generative synthesis with custom control nets, physical particle compositing, and a bespoke spatial synthesizer score.
projects.theFinalFilm: A breathtaking cinematic film that demonstrates that generative AI can achieve true directorial weight and visual gravitas.

projects.title: House of Dragons — Virtual Set
projects.brief: A photorealistic virtual set exploration featuring grand gothic masonry, torchlight physics, and cinematic depth.
projects.challenge: Generating complex architectural stone geometry with consistent multi-angle lighting without physical set construction.
projects.solution: Deployed procedural 3D block-outs as spatial depth guides for generative video diffusion models.
projects.outcome: A production-ready cinematic background sequence that cut concept pre-visualization turnaround from weeks to hours.
projects.theIdea: Ancient stone halls and dragon-lit corridors brought to life through hybrid 3D NeRF spatial models and neural video synthesis.
projects.theApproach: Directorial camera dolly movements with realistic focal depth, atmospheric torch flicker, and authentic medieval material textures.
projects.theExecution: Composited in 4K with deep contrast curves, dynamic ember particles, and subterranean acoustic reverb soundscapes.
projects.theFinalFilm: An evocative fantasy realm environment ready for broadcast virtual production and digital visual effects.

projects.title: Starbucks Brand Reveal

projects.theIdea: To deconstruct iconic brand geometry and reconstruct it with liquid fluidity, paying homage to artisanal coffee craftsmanship.

projects.theExecution: Crafted in After Effects with bespoke motion paths, vector coordinate interpolation, and organic liquid-sheen transitions.

faqs.question: How does BE SOOCIAL balance human creative direction with AI tools?
faqs.answer: AI is our lens and accelerator, not our creative director. Every project begins with human storyboards, art direction, and narrative intent. We deploy proprietary neural pipelines (ComfyUI, generative spatial models, synthetic voice) to produce visual worlds and velocity that would otherwise take months or millions of dollars, while keeping human taste at the center.

faqs.question: What is your typical project timeline and onboarding workflow?
faqs.answer: Rapid creative sprints (AI commercial spots, high-tempo edits, UGC batches) typically deliver in 7 to 14 business days. Full brand overhauls and spatial web builds take between 4 to 8 weeks with dedicated weekly review milestones and private staging environments.

faqs.question: How do you handle licensing, copyrights, and AI model provenance?
faqs.answer: All assets generated through our studio pipelines undergo rigorous copyright and trademark validation. We deliver full commercial exploitation rights, master source exports, and signed indemnity for enterprise broadcast and global digital deployment.

faqs.question: Can you integrate directly with our in-house marketing or engineering team?
faqs.answer: Yes. We frequently act as an embedded high-velocity strike team for venture-backed startups and enterprise creative departments, integrating seamlessly via Slack, Linear, and Figma.
